## Open findings

### High (0)

_None._

### Med (4)

- `byok-load-error-raw-message` — **ByokSection** — Load-error state drops the primary control and shows the raw server message
- `code-host-setup-hint-unbounded-measure` — **CodeHostSection** — The first-setup hint paragraph runs as one unbroken ~1230px line with no `max-width` — `CodeHostSection.svelte:280`
- `guest-mode-toggle-not-exposed-a11y` — **GuestModeSection** — Binary toggle state is not exposed to assistive tech
- `tools-race-permission-during-preset` — **ToolsSection** — Per-tool/domain/group permission controls stay live during a preset apply or clear

### Low (19)

- `ai-output-no-save-confirmation` — **AiOutputSection** — No positive confirmation that a save actually succeeded — `AiOutputSection.svelte:82`
- `byok-hardcoded-spacing` — **ByokSection** — Card spacing and radius are hardcoded, off the shared scale
- `coding-credentials-conditional-fields-unexplained` — **CodingCredentialsSection** — Auth method / Base URL appear and become required with no explanation — `CodingCredentialsSection.svelte:90`
- `debug-icon-buttons-control-height` — **DebugApp** — Icon-only buttons sit at the shared 24px control-height token — `client/shared/ui/Btn.svelte:111`
- `kaneo-access-empty-state-dead-end` — **KaneoAccessSection** — "Not provisioned" empty state still has no next step — `client/settings/sections/KaneoAccessSection.svelte:95`
- `kaneo-access-password-no-copy-rehide` — **KaneoAccessSection** — Revealed password cannot be re-hidden — `client/settings/sections/KaneoAccessSection.svelte:121`
- `members-add-form-alignment-inert` — **MembersSection** — Add-form alignment rule is inert; the primary button is undersized under a full-width input
- `members-empty-state-dead-end` — **MembersSection** — Empty state dead-ends on "No members" — `MembersSection.svelte:162`
- `profile-sparse-layout-minimal-data` — **ProfileSection** — Section looks sparse / unbalanced when data is minimal
- `release-subscription-error-text-spacing` — **ReleaseSubscriptionSection** — Reload-failure inline error line has no spacing token and is unframed — `client/settings/sections/ReleaseSubscriptionSection.svelte:91`
- `repos-egress-silently-normalised` — **ReposSection** — Egress input is silently normalised
- `repos-load-error-no-recovery` — **ReposSection** — Load failures surface the raw backend string with no recovery affordance — `client/settings/sections/ReposSection.svelte:120`
- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `repos-no-heading-element` — **ReposSection** — The section has no heading element — `client/shared/ui/PageHeader.svelte:25`
- `repos-status-not-announced-never-clears` — **ReposSection** — Status messages are positioned away from the action and never clear
- `tools-clear-row-spacing-off-scale` — **ToolsSection** — Two spacing values remain off the token scale — `client/settings/sections/ToolsSection.svelte:472`
- `tools-clear-trigger-looks-like-text` — **ToolsSection** — "Clear admin defaults" trigger still uses the bare `ghost` variant — `client/settings/sections/ToolsSection.svelte:263`
- `tools-dual-confirm-bars-overlap` — **ToolsSection** — Clear-defaults trigger row can render alongside the preset confirm bar — `client/settings/sections/ToolsSection.svelte:260`
- `tools-preset-checkmark-not-decorative` — **ToolsSection** — Active-preset checkmark is redundant with `aria-pressed` for screen readers — `client/settings/sections/ToolsSection.svelte:230`
